description: This file defines the SelectedFilterFieldDecorator class, a wrapper around the SelectedFilterField entity that provides additional functionality such as setting a filter field by ID. It appears to be part of a larger HRM system, specifically related to filtering operations within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: SelectedFilterFieldDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the SelectedFilterField entity providing methods to manipulate filter field references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a SelectedFilterField instance.

methods.name: setFilterFieldById
methods.description: Sets the filter field of the wrapped entity by loading it via its ID using a reference.
